"""Main checks only new findings against the immutable SYCL server base."""
from pathlib import Path
import difflib,fcntl,hashlib,importlib.util,json,time,traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012');BASE=W.parent/'sync-upstream-v0143-server-lifecycle-20261012'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py';assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
def module(name,p):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,p);v=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(v);return v
m=module('server_lint_owner',O);leg=module('server_line_findings',B/'latest-update-mandatory-lints-cpp-v4.py');leg.W=W;leg.P=BASE;leg.U=BASE
ENV=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',MYPY_CACHE_DIR='/dev/null')
def ident(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-update-recheck-server-lints-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=ident(Path(__file__)))
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,cwd=W,allowed=(0,)):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,ENV,cwd,wall=300,cpu=1200,rss_cap=8<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=96<<20,file_cap=64<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save();assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,label
  return c,so.read_text(),se.read_text()
 try:
  link=W/'.lint'
  if not link.exists():link.symlink_to(L,target_is_directory=True)
  assert link.resolve()==L.resolve()
  files=['serve/server.py','serve/frontend.py','serve/test_frontend.py','serve/test_queue_keepalive.py','serve/test_ready_timeout.py','serve/test_tool_name_space.py','serve/test_parser_track.py','serve/test_tool_order_v0143.py','serve/test_quoted_think_end.py','serve/mcp.py','serve/test_server.py']
  r['source_pins']={p:m.sha(W/p) for p in files};existing={p:BASE/p for p in files if (BASE/p).exists()};maps={}
  for name,p in existing.items():
   maps[name]={}
   for a,z,n in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,p.read_text().splitlines(),(W/name).read_text().splitlines(),autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks():
    for i in range(n):maps[name][z+i+1]=a+i+1
  bc,bso,bse=run('baseline-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*existing],BASE,(0,1))
  cc,cso,cse=run('candidate-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],allowed=(0,1))
  for tool in ['flake8','ruff','mypy','codespell','reuse']:assert '== '+tool in bso and '== '+tool in cso,tool
  assert 'skipped (' not in bso+cso and 'possible secret' not in bso+cso
  assert not cso.split('== reuse\n')[-1].strip()
  before=leg.findings(bso+'\n'+bse);after=leg.findings(cso+'\n'+cse,maps);added=sorted(set(after)-set(before),key=repr)
  r['comparison']=dict(baseline_exit=bc['exit_code'],candidate_exit=cc['exit_code'],baseline=before,candidate=after,added=added,normalization='Exact unchanged source path/line/message; new files inherit no findings.')
  save();assert not added,added
  assert all(m.sha(W/p)==h for p,h in r['source_pins'].items());r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as e:r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
